acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Effective nodes equal the exact five-way intersection and are revision pinned.
Tenant policy cannot add a noncanonical node or grant PAGE authority.
A legal-entity overlay is a restrictive subset and cannot re-enable an upstream denial.
Cross-tenant stale or mismatched legal-entity context fails closed without disclosing policy data.
Sidebar selection landing fallback and direct deep link use the same effective revision.
Published revisions are immutable and restore produces a new revision tied to the prior digest.
Author cannot approve or publish; approve publish and restore require step-up.
CAS and idempotency return the original receipt for the same digest and reject mismatches.
Receipt audit and outbox are atomic and crash replay cannot duplicate effective publication.
OFF and SHADOW do not enforce; ENFORCED enrolled tenants fail closed for missing or stale policy.
Seven HR Operations groups and seventeen member nodes validate against installed canonical IA ownership.
Authoring loading empty denied partial failure responsive keyboard and 200-percent zoom states are accessible and leak no unauthorized data.
